map.🩺 治则治法选择建议器: 🩺 Treatment Principle and Method Selection Advisor
map.根据辨证结果选择对应治则治法，涵盖正治反治、治标治本、扶正祛邪、调整阴阳、三因制: Select the corresponding treatment principle and method from the differentiation result, covering treatment on the opposite and same aspects, treating the branch versus the root, supporting upright qi and dispelling pathogens, adjusting yin and yang, and adapting to the three causes
map.正治反治: Treatment on the opposite and same aspects
map.治标治本: Treating the branch versus the root
map.扶正祛邪: Supporting upright qi and dispelling pathogens
map.根据证候性质选择治则: Select the treatment principle by the nature of the pattern
map.真寒假热（阴盛格阳）: True cold with false heat (yin excess repelling yang)
map.真热假寒（阳盛格阴）: True heat with false cold (yang excess repelling yin)
map.邪正盛衰: Strength of pathogen versus healthy qi
map.正虚邪实: Upright qi deficient with pathogen present
map.正治与反治: Treatment on the opposite and same aspects
map.正治：逆其证候性质而治（常规治法）；反治：顺其假象而治（针对真假证候）: Treatment on the opposite works against the nature of the pattern (the conventional method); treatment on the same follows the false appearance (for true and false patterns)
map.用温热药治寒证: Use warming hot medicines for cold patterns
map.用寒凉药治热证: Use cooling cold medicines for heat patterns
map.用补益药治虚证: Use tonifying medicines for deficiency patterns
map.气虚、血虚、阴虚、阳虚: Qi deficiency, blood deficiency, yin deficiency, yang deficiency
map.用攻邪药治实证: Use attacking medicines for excess patterns
map.气滞、血瘀、痰饮、食积: Qi stagnation, blood stasis, phlegm-fluid, food stagnation
map.用温热药治假热证: Use warming hot medicines for false heat patterns
map.用寒凉药治假寒证: Use cooling cold medicines for false cold patterns
map.用补益药治假实证: Use tonifying medicines for false excess patterns
map.真虚假实（脾虚腹胀）: True deficiency with false excess (spleen deficiency abdominal distension)
map.用通利药治假虚证: Use draining medicines for false deficiency patterns
map.真实假虚（热结旁流）: True excess with false deficiency (heat binding with overflow)
map.治标与治本: Treating the branch and the root
map.标病急重，先治标: Branch disease urgent and severe, treat the branch first
map.标症危及生命或影响治本: Branch symptoms threatening life or hindering root treatment
map.大出血先止血；剧痛先止痛: Major bleeding: stop bleeding first; severe pain: relieve pain first
map.缓则治其本: When not urgent, treat the root
map.标症不急，治本为主: Branch symptoms not urgent, treat the root as the main approach
map.脾虚慢泻，健脾治本: Slow diarrhoea from spleen deficiency, strengthen the spleen to treat the root
map.标本均较急重: Both branch and root fairly urgent and severe
map.气虚外感，益气解表同治: Exterior invasion with qi deficiency, boost qi and release the exterior together
map.原发病为本: The primary disease is the root
map.继发病为标: The secondary disease is the branch
map.扶正与祛邪: Supporting upright qi and dispelling pathogens
map.扶助正气，增强抗病力: Support upright qi and strengthen resistance to disease
map.益气、养血、滋阴、温阳: Boost qi, nourish blood, nourish yin, warm yang
map.祛除邪气，消除病因: Remove pathogenic qi and eliminate the cause
map.发汗、清热、泻下、祛湿: Induce sweating, clear heat, purge downward, resolve dampness
map.扶正兼祛邪: Supporting upright qi while also dispelling pathogens
map.以扶正为主，兼祛邪: Mainly support upright qi, also dispel pathogens
map.补中益气兼消食: Tonify middle and boost qi while relieving food stagnation
map.祛邪兼扶正: Dispelling pathogens while also supporting upright qi
map.以祛邪为主，兼扶正: Mainly dispel pathogens, also support upright qi
map.邪盛为主，兼有正虚: Pathogen dominant, with upright qi deficiency
map.先扶正后祛邪: Support upright qi first, then dispel pathogens
map.正虚严重，不耐攻伐: Severe deficiency, cannot tolerate attacking and draining
map.先健脾后再攻下: Strengthen the spleen first, then purge downward
map.先祛邪后扶正: Dispel pathogens first, then support upright qi
map.邪盛正虚，邪去正自复: Pathogen dominant with qi deficiency; once the pathogen goes, upright qi recovers on its own
map.先清热后养阴: Clear heat first, then nourish yin
map.热者寒之（清泻阳热）: Treat heat with cold (drain yang heat)
map.寒者热之（温散阴寒）: Treat cold with heat (warm and disperse yin cold)
map.阳中求阴（滋阴为主，佐以补阳）: Seek yin within yang (mainly nourish yin, assisted by tonifying yang)
map.阴中求阳（补阳为主，佐以滋阴）: Seek yang within yin (mainly tonify yang, assisted by nourishing yin)
map.慎用温热药，宜辛凉平剂: Use warming hot medicines cautiously; acrid-cool mild formulas are appropriate
map.慎用寒凉药，宜辛温剂: Use cooling cold medicines cautiously; acrid-warm formulas are appropriate
map.暑季治病注意清暑化湿: In summer, remember to clear summer heat and resolve dampness
map.体质多瘦弱，用药宜清凉: Constitutions tend to be thin and weak, so medicines should be cooling
map.体质多壮实，用药宜温燥: Constitutions tend to be robust, so medicines should be warming and drying
map.多湿邪为患，注意化湿: Dampness predominates; remember to resolve dampness
map.老人虚多宜补；小儿脏腑嫩，药宜轻: The elderly are often deficient and suit tonification; children have immature zang-fu so medicines should be gentle
map.女性注意经期、孕期、产后用药禁忌: Women: note the medication contraindications during menstruation, pregnancy and postpartum
map.阳虚宜温；阴虚宜凉；痰湿宜燥湿: Yang deficiency suits warmth; yin deficiency suits coolness; phlegm-dampness suits drying dampness
map.本工具仅供中医学习和参考，临床用药须由执业中医师辨证施治，切勿自行用药。: This tool is for TCM study and reference only. Clinical prescribing must be done by a licensed TCM practitioner after syndrome differentiation. Never self-medicate.
map.📚 深度解析：治则治法建议: 📚 Deep dive: treatment principle and method advice
map.祛邪扶正: Dispelling pathogens and supporting upright qi
map.nature=寒→zhengzhiMap 取「正治（寒者热之）」；urgency: With nature=cold the treatment principle map gives "treatment on the opposite (treat cold with heat)"; with urgency set to treat the branch in urgency, the branch-root map rescues the branch first.
map.nature=真寒假热→取「反治（热因热用）」，用温热药治假热；xzMap 定祛: With nature=true cold with false heat it gives "treatment on the same (use heat for heat)", using warming hot medicines for the false heat; the nature-reinforce-defence map sets the balance between dispelling pathogens and supporting upright qi.
map.正治反治？: What are treatment on the opposite and same?
map.正治逆其象（寒者热之），反治从其假象（热因热用），用于真假寒热。: Treatment on the opposite works against the appearance (treat cold with heat), while treatment on the same follows the false appearance (use heat for heat); both are used for true and false cold and heat.
map.标本怎么定？: How are branch and root determined?
map.急则治标、缓则治本、标本俱急者标本兼顾。: Treat the branch in urgency, treat the root when not urgent, and address both when both are urgent.
